text: Design multi-agent coordination with specialized roles
description: BONUS FEATURE: Create agent swarm architecture with specialized roles - planner agent (decomposes aims), developer agent (writes code), QA agent (tests/verifies), deployment agent (ships). Agents coordinate through shared .bowman state, passing work via aims, with trust-based handoffs. Demonstrates coordination at scale.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026 as hackathon-oriented architecture noise. Fixed planner/developer/QA/deployment roles and a separate swarm layer are not needed: agents coordinate through ordinary aims, contribution edges, statuses, reflections, and human-dependent boundaries. Reconsider only if a real workflow exposes a concrete coordination failure that the graph cannot express.

reflection: Relevance review found this was framed as a BONUS FEATURE that “demonstrates coordination at scale,” not a validated user need. Preserving the intention here prevents a future agent from recreating a role taxonomy without evidence.
